_notes: Player-facing descriptions for generated materials and cores (Tools/monster_gen/generate.js merges these into Data/Items/materials.json and adds icon ids). Key = item id. Owned by items-designer.
itm_mat_slime_jelly: Cool, wobbling jelly scraped from a slime. Alchemists boil it into the base of healing draughts.
itm_mat_gel_core: The firm heart of a slime, no bigger than a plum. It keeps its shape for years and sells for pocket change.
itm_core_f: A pebble-sized core that stays warm after a monster falls. The first thing every Guild rookie learns to collect; crafters use it to bind a gear's first spark.
itm_core_e: A core the size of a thumb, humming faintly. Strong enough to finish E-rank gear and to brew proper healing potions.
itm_core_d: A dense, glassy core with a steady pulse. Alchemists pay well for it, and D-rank recipes ask for one.
itm_core_c: A bright core that is warm to the touch for a full day. Needed to forge C-rank gear that holds an edge or a ward.
itm_core_b: A core the size of a fist, heavy with stored power. B-rank masterwork recipes call for one, and so do some quiet Guild commissions.
itm_core_a: A rare A-rank core that glows when you hold it near a heartbeat. Shops buy it, but few shops can afford to stock it.
itm_core_s: An S-rank core, cold and impossibly dense. Kept in lead-lined cases; the Guild logs every one that changes hands.
itm_core_ss: An SS-rank core. Light bends faintly around it. Legend says each one is the last echo of something that should not have fallen.
itm_core_sss: An SSS-rank core. Even held in a closed fist, the room goes quiet. Reserved for work of national consequence.
itm_core_ex: An EX-rank core, older than any record of it. No price is posted; the Guild only says that it exists.
itm_mat_relic_shard: A sliver of worked stone from a ruin older than the Guild. Scholars would like to know where you found it.
itm_mat_goblin_ear: A notched goblin ear, the Guild's proof of a cleared warren. Small bounty, big stack.
itm_mat_crude_blade: A goblin-made blade blank, pitted and bent. A smith can re-edge it into something honest.
itm_mat_stolen_trinket: A bit of shiny junk a goblin lifted from a traveller. Some owners will pay to get theirs back.
itm_mat_kobold_fang: A short, yellowed kobold fang. Strung on cord it makes a decent luck charm.
itm_mat_scrap_metal: Bent nails, snapped blades and cracked buckles. Torvald calls it the cheapest honest iron in town.
itm_mat_candle_stub: A guttering candle end from a monster's nest. Wax and wick, with a bit of old light left in it.
itm_mat_pelt: A rough, serviceable animal pelt. The tannery turns it into caps, jerkins and hilt wrap.
itm_mat_fang: A clean white fang from a wolf or boar. Smiths set it into blades; hunters wear it for luck.
itm_mat_prime_meat: A good cut of fresh monster meat. Cook it the same day and it feeds a table.
itm_mat_cursed_fur: Dark fur that seems to hold onto the shadows. It needs shade essence to calm it before it can be worn.
itm_mat_silver_bane_claw: A grey claw that dulls ordinary steel. Alloyed into a blade, it bites back at beasts that shrug off normal edges.
itm_mat_carapace_shard: A curved plate of beetle shell, light and tough. Riveted to leather it turns a fair blow.
itm_mat_silk: Fine spider silk, strong as thread and soft as a scarf. Weavers use it for hoods, robes and scrolls.
itm_mat_venom_sac: A sealed sac of pale venom. Handle it carefully; alchemists distil it into coatings and antidotes.
itm_mat_killer_mandible: A serrated mandible from a hunting insect. Sharp enough to cut the cord it hangs from.
itm_mat_stinger: A hollow stinger still crackling with trapped charge. Scroll-makers draw storm ink from it.
itm_mat_bone_dust: Fine grey dust from a restless skeleton. It is only dust, whatever the stories say.
itm_mat_grave_cloth: A shred of shroud that has outlasted its owner. Weavers say it takes dye strangely.
itm_mat_soul_ember: A faint orange spark that burns without fuel. It lights a rune of heat.
itm_mat_shade_essence: A cold wisp bottled from a shade. A little calms cursed fur; a lot makes the bottle sweat.
itm_mat_night_shard: A fragment of black glass that only gleams after dark. Woven into cloth, it softens the evening.
itm_mat_tusk: A heavy curved tusk, yellow at the root. Good for hilts, mace heads and amulets.
itm_mat_giant_s_hide: A slab of thick, stone-scraped hide. The tannery calls it stubborn and soles it into boots.
itm_mat_crude_iron: Lumpy smelted iron, still full of grit. Torvald can work it into plain, dependable gear.
itm_mat_horn: A ridged horn, hard as a pot handle. Carvers and smiths both buy it.
itm_mat_labyrinth_bronze: Old bronze pulled from the Labyrinth walls, green at the edges. Beaten thin it becomes surprisingly light armour.
itm_mat_scale: A palm-sized lizard scale, glossy and overlapping. Armourers stitch them in rows.
itm_mat_reptile_eye: A yellow, slit-pupilled eye kept in brine. Alchemists swear by it for night sight.
itm_mat_tail_meat: Lean meat from a lizard's tail. Slow-roasted, it is the best thing in a long road's menu.
itm_mat_dragon_scale: A small scale from a drake, warm to the touch. Hard enough to crack a chisel.
itm_mat_dragon_blood: A vial of thick, warm drake blood. It never quite cools, and alchemists treat it with respect.
itm_mat_dragon_heart: The heart of a young drake, still faintly beating in its salt jar. Rare, valuable and not for the squeamish.
itm_mat_golem_core: A smooth stone heart etched with tiny grooves. It holds the pattern that once made a golem walk.
itm_mat_rune_plate: A blank slab of rune-carving stone. Khazdur masons cut every glyph onto one.
itm_mat_gear: A hand-turned brass gear from an automaton. Runesmiths use it to anchor the Anvil Rune.
itm_mat_elemental_essence: A drop of raw elemental force held in glass. It never stays one temperature for long.
itm_mat_spirit_mote: A drifting speck of spirit-light. Catch one in a jar and it lights your desk for a week.
itm_mat_sap: Sticky, sweet tree sap. Cooks, alchemists and bomb-makers all keep a jar.
itm_mat_seed: A handful of wild seeds. Plant them, grind them, or put them in the stew.
itm_mat_spore_cap: A mushroom cap that glows a little in the dark. Safe to eat once roasted.
itm_mat_demon_core: A black core with an ember at its centre. It feels angry for no reason; do not carry it near the bread.
itm_mat_horn_shard: A chip broken from a demon's horn. Warm to hold, and it smells faintly of struck flint.
itm_mat_brimstone: A yellow lump of fire-stone from deep rock. A pinch warms a drink; a handful warms a fortress.
itm_mat_fish_scale: A silver scale that catches the light like coin. Used in Tide Runes for their cool edge.
itm_mat_pearl: A small, round pearl from river or pond. Jewellers set it in bands and charms.
itm_mat_ink_sac: A full ink sac, blue-black and slow to dry. Scribes and scroll-makers always need more.
itm_mat_feather: A long, glossy flight feather. Light as breath; used for charms and wind-touched scrolls.
itm_mat_talon: A hooked bird talon, sharp at the tip. Bound into charms for luck in the hunt.
itm_mat_egg: A speckled monster egg, warm and heavy. Bakers prize them.
itm_mat_chimera_heart: A three-chambered heart that still beats slowly. Alchemists and masters of the forge both want it.
itm_mat_mythic_horn: A single spiral horn, light as a reed and strong as steel. Its owner is long gone; its worth is not.
itm_mat_serpent_scale: A broad, patterned scale from a giant serpent. It flexes with the wearer and shrugs off cuts.
itm_mat_temple_gold: Soft, pale gold taken from an old shrine. It carries a faint memory of bells.
itm_mat_horsehair: Long, coarse hair from a spectral horse. Strong enough to pad armour or string a bow.
itm_mat_painted_barding: A piece of ghost-cavalry barding, its paint still bright. Collectors pay more than armourers do.
itm_mat_rider_s_lantern: A tiny lantern from a ghost rider's saddle. It still burns, though nothing is inside.
itm_mat_cursed_iron: Black iron that hums when the lights go out. Smiths work it with respect and leather gloves.
itm_mat_stolen_bolt: A crossbow bolt a thief has been saving. Not for you, but you may as well have it.
itm_mat_gremlin_ear: A small, pointed ear, Guild proof of a cleared gremlin nest.
itm_mat_unreal_fragment: A sliver of something that was not quite there. It flickers when you look away.
itm_mat_eye_of_nothing: A glassy sphere that reflects nothing at all. Scholars keep it in a drawer and do not discuss it.
itm_mat_spirit_paper: A sheet of thin paper cut with prayer marks. Tucked into a hem it is said to turn bad luck aside.
itm_mat_fox_fire: A flicker of cool blue flame that never burns. It follows you home if you let it.
itm_mat_dungeon_core_shard: A chip from the heart of a dungeon. It hums when you walk near a dungeon door.
itm_mat_vesper_glass: Dusk-coloured glass that holds the last light of evening. Prized by lamp-makers and a few tired poets.
itm_mat_captured_soul_light: A small blue light in a glass bead. It brightens near those who are grieving, and nobody knows why.
itm_mat_desert_glass: Glass formed where lightning hit the dunes. Pale green and sharper than it looks.
itm_mat_sand_pearl: A pearl made in the sand, not the sea. Warm in the hand and strangely heavy.
itm_mat_coin_purse: A small, worn purse with a few coppers left in the seam. Return it to its owner if you can.
itm_mat_weapon: A battered weapon taken from a defeated foe. Not worth wielding, but the scrap is good.
itm_mat_bounty_proof: A scrap of badge or cloth that proves a bounty. Take it to the Guild board.
itm_mat_soft_fur: Soft, fine fur from a gentle beast. Tailors line cloaks with it.
itm_mat_shed_scale: A scale naturally shed during a moult. Thin, light and good for charms.
